name: Jesus' sisters (unnamed)
title: Jesus' biological sisters
summary: Jesus' sisters are mentioned in the Gospels, but never by name. They were daughters of Mary and Joseph, and grew up with Jesus in Nazareth. Their existence confirms that Jesus had a normal family situation with several siblings.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned by the people of Nazareth
keyEvents.description: When Jesus taught in the synagogue in his hometown, the people mentioned his sisters as proof that they knew his family and background.

keyEvents.title: Referred to in the Gospel of Mark
keyEvents.description: Mark confirms that Jesus had sisters who lived among the people of Nazareth, which caused people to wonder at his wisdom and miracles.

keyEvents.title: The family comes to take Jesus away
keyEvents.description: Jesus' family, probably including his sisters, came to take him away when they heard about the crowds and were worried about him.
